standing: Proposed definition obligations; symbolic cases are not runtime tests or authority

cases.stimulus: Complete live TASK request/write/result, one final item and completed turn; exact base references
cases.required_outcome: Eligible for proposed answer mint only; no truth or authority

cases.stimulus: Item and terminal arrive before correlated start result, all after dispatch
cases.required_outcome: Wait for consistent result; do not reject solely response-late order

cases.stimulus: Matching transcript/history page but no original App request
cases.required_outcome: Reject fresh authorship mint

cases.stimulus: Copied private receipt projection is deserialized with all correct hashes
cases.required_outcome: Reject fresh capability; cold consistency may still pass

cases.stimulus: Fork/injected historical message repeats matching answer text
cases.required_outcome: Reject original authorship inference; fresh request/emission required

cases.stimulus: Original request write incomplete or result missing
cases.required_outcome: No mint; retain actual pending/unknown outcome

cases.stimulus: Matching IDs but different home/spawn generation or source pipe
cases.required_outcome: Reject join, never choose current source by matching text

cases.stimulus: Supplied role is TASK but renderer labels answer manager
cases.required_outcome: Reject review role promotion

cases.stimulus: Distinct final item IDs carry identical text
cases.required_outcome: Reject ambiguous selected authorship; no last-item winner

cases.stimulus: Same event identity/position has conflicting frame hash
cases.required_outcome: Reject inconsistent source history

cases.stimulus: Final item exists but terminal failed/interrupted or phase missing
cases.required_outcome: Reject mint; no successful-stage inference

cases.stimulus: Source closes immediately before mint; late complete frames arrive
cases.required_outcome: No mint; preserve gap, no history fallback

cases.stimulus: Answer minted, source closes before final recording
cases.required_outcome: Historical answer recording eligible subject to base/registry checks; no new authority

cases.stimulus: Answer minted; review not minted before review-source closes
cases.required_outcome: Retain answer; review unavailable; integration outstanding

cases.stimulus: Answer historical, review still current
cases.required_outcome: Keep per-contribution liveness distinct; review cannot reactivate answer

cases.stimulus: Cancellation wins while late answer completion is pending
cases.required_outcome: Discard working set; no resurrection or promise supplier rollback

cases.stimulus: Source closure occurs without user cancellation
cases.required_outcome: Do not discard already minted exact contribution merely from closure

cases.stimulus: Same account ID/path now contains changed bytes
cases.required_outcome: Refuse live rebind; prior selected subject historical, new preparation needed

cases.stimulus: Answer bytes gain one trailing whitespace; prior review unchanged
cases.required_outcome: Reject review exact-byte binding even if parsed message equal

cases.stimulus: Answer omits carried base gap or cites unknown fact
cases.required_outcome: Reject semantic preparation; schema shape alone insufficient

cases.stimulus: Manager review shares answer request/conversation
cases.required_outcome: Reject separate-manager evidence

cases.stimulus: Positive content review has no graph plan
cases.required_outcome: Do not fabricate plan or call cannot_assess; representation gap remains

cases.stimulus: reviewed_for_integration with null plan
cases.required_outcome: Reject existing cold semantic check; no authority minted

cases.stimulus: Two valid manager reviews conflict, later timestamp preferred
cases.required_outcome: No automatic winner; preserve bounded conflict evidence or refuse

cases.stimulus: One prepared CAM payload already exists on CCE admission
cases.required_outcome: Refuse new working set, no eviction/second payload

cases.stimulus: Exact final serialized UTF8 escapes exceed1MiB
cases.required_outcome: Refuse before slot exposure, no authored-text truncation

cases.stimulus: Freeze succeeds then publish/cancel fails uncertainly
cases.required_outcome: Identity remains consumed; original Attempt retained; no retry/token revival

cases.stimulus: App restarts with no prefreeze durable record
cases.required_outcome: Hot status unavailable, not proof no prior emission/write; no automatic resume

cases.stimulus: Final cold record hashes resolve and roles look valid
cases.required_outcome: Historical recorded content only; cannot mint new live source/run/human act

cases.stimulus: Future separately authorized graph attempt has started when cancel occurs
cases.required_outcome: Preserve actual/uncertain attempt; this amendment cannot erase/rollback it

cases.stimulus: Native final answer is valid JSON but says only done
cases.required_outcome: Syntactic acceptance not substantive quality; manager assessment remains needed

cases.stimulus: Manager comments accepted/approved in free text
cases.required_outcome: No A5/A6 or person act inferred
